_comment: THE THING, NOT THE KNOWLEDGE (owner, 2026-09-04), and the first item in the mod that
enters the world by purchase. A totem drops from an evoker and this world has no raids,
so nothing else here can produce one at any price - which is the point of it being on the
shelf rather than in a loot table.
Dearer than any sheet because a sheet is bought once and a totem is spent. First-pass;
tuning belongs with the balance pass (#36).
